data.effects:
Lively yet giving off a theatrical impression, she enjoys group activities, always following trends and imitating others, and dislikes being alone. When she has nothing to do, she streams with Carol, gaining audience approval through her lifelike imitations and her naturally goofy personality. She often does nonsensical things in life, but is actually very good at getting along with people and considerate of her friends' feelings. In battle, she likes to be at the forefront, muttering strange "lines":
"Rush B, GOGOGO!"

level1.description:
Selects one tile within a cross-shaped area of 3 to 6 tiles, lands on the selected tile, and deals Hydro damage equal to 130% of attack to the nearest enemy target within 6 tiles.

If both the tile before skill usage and the tile when dealing damage are Hydro tiles, then this skill can be used again and the damage dealt is increased by 30%.

This skill can be used again up to a maximum of 1 additional time.
